registration: none; not a registered trademark; no legal claim of exclusivity beyond ordinary署名/来源标识
grant: auto-on-valid-evidence; no application, account, fee, or human approval
requiredDisclaimer: 非官方 · 非认证 · 非安全审计 / Not official, not a certification, not a security audit
allowed: display the level word with status, scope, date, and an evidence link
link the badge to the evidence record or verify page
reproduce the unmodified clause text with attribution
rules: A mark must never appear without its evidence status and date.
A mark must never be sold, bundled with paid ranking, or used as a condition of market access.
A modified clause must not carry the original mark.
The disclaimer must be visible in the same view as the mark, not only in a linked page.
A withdrawn or expired record must show 'withdrawn' or 'stale', not the old PASS.

termination.trigger: misuse after a 30-day written cure period
termination.effect: withdraw the right to use the marks; public record in governance/decision-log.md
termination.survival: accurate historical references may remain with a correction note
